ideas.name: FrostSafe self-draining rain-barrel diverter and tap
ideas.concept: Downspout diverter plus barrel tap with a passive thermal drain element that opens at about 2C so barrel, hoses and fittings empty themselves before freeze; no manual winter swap.
ideas.target_customer: Allotment (kolonihave/kolonilott) holders and cabin owners with rain barrels, bought individually or via association group-buys.
ideas.problem_solved: Today owners must drain the barrel and disconnect the downspout before hard frost; existing diverters only have a manual summer/winter lever or plug; cracked fittings in spring.
ideas.moat_mechanism: German utility model (Gebrauchsmuster) on the integrated thermal-drain diverter, EUR 30 e-filing fee per DPMA (plus attorney if wanted), plus EU registered design EUR 350. Utility model is registered without substantive examination, so it deters but is not bulletproof; needs a freedom-to-operate check because thermostatic drain valves exist for plumbing. Copycat in 6 months could not sell an identical integrated mechanism in DE/DK without risk, but could design around. Channel moat: group-buy via allotment federations. Defensibility 3 at best, Medium-Low confidence.
ideas.trend_evidence: Rutgers extension and vendors describe manual winterising, winter-mode levers and plugs only; no frost-proof or self-draining diverter found. Rain barrels described as common among Swedish allotment holders. Kolonihaveforbundet represents about 39,280 gardens in 389 associations (2021), ~62,000 allotment gardens total in Denmark.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 9-12 at 500 units (HDPE moulded housing + thermal drain element). ASSUMPTION, Low
ideas.one_off_tooling_eur: 3000-4500 (one aluminium injection mould) + ~400 IP filings. ASSUMPTION
ideas.channel_edge: Allotment federation newsletters/group-buys and Shopify; seasonal peak Sep-Oct (pre-frost) and Mar-Apr. Association B2B gives low CAC; not an existing founder relationship, must be built.

ideas.name: Rodent-proof seasonal crawl-space vent set (Sommar/Vinter)
ideas.concept: Stainless-mesh rodent-proof foundation vent with a sealed winter/summer-closure slide that stays mouse-proof in every position, sold as a 6-8 vent set with sizing card for Nordic cabins' vent openings.
ideas.target_customer: Second-home owners with ventilated crawl spaces (sommarstuga/hytte), builders' merchants, small builders and installers.
ideas.problem_solved: Insurers/Anticimex advise securing vents with metal mesh against rodents; forum users debate closing vents in summer vs open in winter; Boverket warns outdoor-air ventilated crawl spaces carry damp/mould risk. Cheap vents either do not close or let mice in.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Utility model (DE EUR 30 e-filing, DK brugsmodel not verified) on the closure-with-mesh-retained mechanism + EU registered design EUR 350. Existing automatic vents use bimetal coils (US listings), so an auto version is not novel; novelty must be rodent-proof closing. Building-trade channel via founders' ex-VELUX relationships with merchants/installers is a relationship moat, not a legal one. Defensibility 2-3, Medium-Low confidence; liability note: do not claim moisture-damage prevention.
ideas.trend_evidence: SCB: about 634k fritidshus in Sweden (2025 table via Byggahus), 628,164 in 2024. TV4/TT advice to cover vents with metal mesh and seal foundation holes. Multiple byggahus threads (3,581 reads on closing vents in summer). Boverket notes outdoor-air ventilation risks.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 4-7 per vent (stamped stainless mesh + PP frame). ASSUMPTION, Low
ideas.channel_edge: Builders' merchants and installers through founder network; Shopify set bundle for autumn closing season (Sep-Nov).

ideas.name: Cabin well/lake-water cartridge filter with proprietary cartridge format
ideas.concept: Compact filter housing for cabins without mains water, using a proprietary keyed cartridge (sediment + humus/carbon) sold as annual refill packs; analysis-based cartridge choice card.
ideas.target_customer: Cabin owners on private wells or lake water; torp/hytte owners.
ideas.problem_solved: Cartridge filters recommended for holiday homes; owners report about EUR 10+ per cartridge and frequent changes; forum threads ask for simple filters for torp.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Consumable lock-in: EU registered design EUR 350 for cartridge/cap geometry + keyed non-standard bayonet so generic 10-inch cartridges do not fit. Honest weakness: Chinese clones of a keyed cartridge could appear; food-contact compliance (Reg 1935/2004, ASSUMPTION) costs migration testing (est. EUR 800-1500). Avoid health/purification claims (regulated). Defensibility 3, Low confidence.
ideas.trend_evidence: Forum estimate: cartridge over 100 SEK, ~10 changes/yr; Hornbach: cartridge filters suit holiday homes, analyse water first; threads on filters for torp/summer cabins and lake water. No Nordic keyed-format competitor checked.
ideas.price_point_eur: 79-109 housing kit; cartridges 12-16 each. ASSUMPTION, Low
ideas.channel_edge: Shopify refill subscription, cabin-forum/Facebook groups; installers (VVS) via founder network for add-on sales.

ideas.name: Van cab thermal screens, 3D-pattern set for Nordic van models
ideas.concept: Multi-layer insulated cab and windscreen screens cut from laser-measured patterns for 4-6 top Nordic van chassis, with a patented-or-registered clip system, sold direct with VAT included.
ideas.target_customer: Van-life/camper owners and husbil owners in SE/DK winters.
ideas.problem_solved: UK vendors (Thermomat, Comfortz) dominate; Nordic buyers pay import charges; fit depends on exact generation.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Weak: pattern library built from scanning vehicles (know-how, not IP) + EU registered design EUR 350 for the fixing clip. Copycats can scan too, so defensibility 2; value is price point and fit. Listed to be honest rather than rated high.
ideas.trend_evidence: Swedish husbil registrations Jan-Oct 2026: 5,484 vs 3,845 (partly dealer pre-registration for Euro 6); caravans 1,226 vs 1,366. UK listings: Comfortz Crafter cover 179.99 GBP, Ducato 135 GBP, JK Thermomat kits from 49.95 GBP. Search found no Swedish/Danish seller (not exhaustive).
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 30-45 per set at 60 sets. ASSUMPTION, Low
ideas.channel_edge: Campervan Facebook groups, YouTube build channels, campsites; Shopify. Higher ticket absorbs CAC.

ideas.name: Closable sauna ventilation kit with airflow card
ideas.concept: Set of supply/exhaust valves with sealing slide closure, thermowood frames and a Nordic-language airflow placement card for DIY sauna and attefallshus-sauna builds.
ideas.target_customer: DIY sauna builders, small builders and garden-sauna installers.
ideas.problem_solved: Forums show conflicting placement advice and need for valves closable when not heating; Bauhaus sells basic Saunia plate valves.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Weak/honest: EU registered design EUR 350 only; B2B channel via building-industry network (unproven for sauna). Defensibility 2; include only if a utility model on the sealing closure proves novel in an FTO check.
ideas.trend_evidence: Many byggahus threads on bastu ventilation (e.g. attefallshus + bastu); retailer Bauhaus sells Saunia plate valves.
ideas.channel_edge: Installers and timber/sauna builders via network; Shopify. Moat is weak.
